```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Interactive 3D picture of a joint pdf: the domain as a blue floor, the pdf
# as a surface, and an event's volume in orange (top plus walls to the floor)
plotly_pdf_volume <- function(f, x_lim, y_lim,
                              in_domain = function(x, y) rep(TRUE, length(x)),
                              domain_corners,
                              in_event = NULL, event_corners = NULL,
                              z_max, z_ratio = 0.7, n = 121) {
  xs <- seq(x_lim[1], x_lim[2], length.out = n)
  ys <- seq(y_lim[1], y_lim[2], length.out = n)
  grid <- expand_grid(y = ys, x = xs) |>
    mutate(domain = in_domain(x, y),
           height = if_else(domain, f(x, y), NA_real_),
           event = if (is.null(in_event)) 0 else as.numeric(domain & in_event(x, y)))
  as_mat <- function(v) matrix(v, nrow = n, ncol = n, byrow = TRUE)
  grey_orange <- list(c(0, "#9fb8c8"), c(1, "#E89543"))

  # Floor: one flat polygon at height 0 over the domain
  floor_x <- domain_corners[, 1]
  floor_y <- domain_corners[, 2]
  p <- plot_ly(height = 650) |>
    add_trace(type = "mesh3d", x = floor_x, y = floor_y, z = 0 * floor_x,
              delaunayaxis = "z", color = I("#29abe0"), opacity = 0.3,
              hoverinfo = "skip", name = "Possible values (domain)") |>
    add_surface(x = xs, y = ys, z = as_mat(grid$height),
                surfacecolor = as_mat(grid$event), cmin = 0, cmax = 1,
                colorscale = grey_orange, opacity = 0.9, showscale = FALSE,
                name = "Joint pdf",
                hovertemplate = "x = %{x:.2f}<br>y = %{y:.2f}<br>f(x, y) = %{z:.3f}<extra></extra>")

  if (!is.null(event_corners)) {
    corners <- rbind(event_corners, event_corners[1, ])
    for (k in 1:(nrow(corners) - 1)) {
      s <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 40)
      wall_x <- corners[k, 1] + s * (corners[k + 1, 1] - corners[k, 1])
      wall_y <- corners[k, 2] + s * (corners[k + 1, 2] - corners[k, 2])
      wall_top <- f(wall_x, wall_y)
      p <- p |> add_surface(x = rbind(wall_x, wall_x), y = rbind(wall_y, wall_y),
                            z = rbind(0 * wall_top, wall_top),
                            surfacecolor = matrix(1, 2, 40), cmin = 0, cmax = 1,
                            colorscale = grey_orange, opacity = 0.55,
                            showscale = FALSE, hoverinfo = "skip")
    }
  }

  p |> layout(
    showlegend = FALSE,
    margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 0, b = 0),
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "x"), yaxis = list(title = "y"),
      zaxis = list(title = "f(x, y)", range = c(0, z_max)),
      aspectmode = "manual", aspectratio = list(x = 1, y = 1, z = z_ratio),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.5, y = -1.6, z = 0.9))))
}
```

Each plot below is an interactive version of a static 3D plot in the [Lesson 15 slides](15_Joint_distributions.qmd).

-   **Drag** to rotate, **scroll** to zoom, and **double-click** to reset the view.
-   **Hover** over the surface to see $x$, $y$, and the height $f_{X,Y}(x,y)$.
-   **Blue floor:** the possible values (where $f_{X,Y}(x,y) > 0$).
-   **Orange:** the event. Its volume, from the floor up to the pdf, is the probability we approximate with simulation.

## Example 1: the joint pmf {#ex1-pmf}

Two draws without replacement from a box with balls 1, 2, and 3. Each stick stands on a pair $(x, y)$, and its height is $p_{X,Y}(x,y)$: $\frac16$ for each pair of different balls, and 0 on the diagonal (the $\times$ marks), because the same ball can't be drawn twice.

```{r}
ex1_pmf <- expand_grid(x = 1:3, y = 1:3) |>
  mutate(prob = if_else(x == y, 0, 1/6))

ex1_sticks <- ex1_pmf |>
  filter(prob > 0) |>
  mutate(id = row_number()) |>
  reframe(x = c(x, x, NA), y = c(y, y, NA), z = c(0, prob, NA), .by = id)

floor_lines <- bind_rows(
  tibble(x = rep(c(0.5, 3.5, NA), 3), y = rep(1:3, each = 3)),
  tibble(x = rep(1:3, each = 3), y = rep(c(0.5, 3.5, NA), 3))
) |>
  mutate(z = if_else(is.na(x) | is.na(y), NA_real_, 0))

plot_ly(height = 650) |>
  add_trace(type = "mesh3d", x = c(0.5, 3.5, 3.5, 0.5), y = c(0.5, 0.5, 3.5, 3.5),
            z = c(0, 0, 0, 0), delaunayaxis = "z", color = I("#29abe0"),
            opacity = 0.3, hoverinfo = "skip") |>
  add_trace(data = floor_lines, x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z, type = "scatter3d",
            mode = "lines", line = list(color = "#bbbbbb", width = 2),
            hoverinfo = "skip") |>
  add_trace(data = ex1_sticks, x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z, type = "scatter3d",
            mode = "lines", line = list(color = "#E89543", width = 10),
            hoverinfo = "skip") |>
  add_trace(data = filter(ex1_pmf, prob > 0), x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~prob,
            type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
            marker = list(color = "#E89543", size = 6),
            hovertemplate = "(x, y) = (%{x}, %{y})<br>p(x, y) = %{z:.4f}<extra></extra>") |>
  add_trace(data = filter(ex1_pmf, prob == 0), x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~prob,
            type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
            marker = list(color = "#666666", size = 6, symbol = "x"),
            hovertemplate = "(x, y) = (%{x}, %{y})<br>p(x, y) = 0<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(
    showlegend = FALSE,
    margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 0, b = 0),
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "x", tickvals = 1:3),
      yaxis = list(title = "y", tickvals = 1:3),
      zaxis = list(title = "p(x, y)", range = c(0, 0.25)),
      aspectmode = "manual", aspectratio = list(x = 1, y = 1, z = 0.7),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.5, y = -1.6, z = 0.9))))
```

## 2D grid sampling {#grid-sampling}

A small grid for $f_{X,Y}(x,y) = \frac32 y^2$, $0 \leq x \leq 2$, $0 \leq y \leq 1$. Each stick is one ticket: taller sticks are more likely to be drawn.

```{r}
small_grid_2d <- expand_grid(x = seq(0, 2, by = 0.5), y = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) |>
  mutate(height = 3/2 * y^2)

sticks <- small_grid_2d |>
  mutate(id = row_number()) |>
  reframe(x = c(x, x, NA), y = c(y, y, NA), z = c(0, height, NA), .by = id)

plotly_pdf_volume(
  f = function(x, y) 3/2 * y^2, x_lim = c(0, 2), y_lim = c(0, 1),
  domain_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(2, 0), c(2, 1), c(0, 1)), z_max = 1.6
) |>
  add_trace(data = sticks, x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z, type = "scatter3d",
            mode = "lines", line = list(color = "#29abe0", width = 6),
            hoverinfo = "skip") |>
  add_trace(data = small_grid_2d, x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~height,
            type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
            marker = list(color = "#29abe0", size = 5),
            hovertemplate = "ticket (%{x}, %{y})<br>height = %{z:.3f}<extra></extra>") |>
  style(opacity = 0.25, traces = 2)
```

## Example 2: the joint pdf {#ex2-pdf}

$f_{X,Y}(x,y) = \frac32 y^2$, for $0 \leq x \leq 2$, $0 \leq y \leq 1$. The total volume under the surface is 1.

```{r}
plotly_pdf_volume(
  f = function(x, y) 3/2 * y^2, x_lim = c(0, 2), y_lim = c(0, 1),
  domain_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(2, 0), c(2, 1), c(0, 1)), z_max = 1.6
)
```

## Example 2: volume for $\mathbb{P}(0 \leq X \leq 1, 0 \leq Y \leq \frac12)$ {#ex2-volume}

```{r}
plotly_pdf_volume(
  f = function(x, y) 3/2 * y^2, x_lim = c(0, 2), y_lim = c(0, 1),
  domain_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(2, 0), c(2, 1), c(0, 1)),
  in_event = function(x, y) x <= 1 & y <= 0.5,
  event_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(1, 0), c(1, 0.5), c(0, 0.5)), z_max = 1.6
)
```

## Example 3: the joint pdf {#ex3-pdf}

Constant density on the square $0 \leq x \leq 4$, $0 \leq y \leq 4$: $f_{X,Y}(x,y) = \frac{1}{16}$.

```{r}
plotly_pdf_volume(
  f = function(x, y) 1/16 + 0 * x, x_lim = c(0, 4), y_lim = c(0, 4),
  domain_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(4, 0), c(4, 4), c(0, 4)), z_max = 0.1
)
```

## Example 3, part 1: volume for $\mathbb{P}(|X - Y| < 2)$ {#ex3-abs}

```{r}
plotly_pdf_volume(
  f = function(x, y) 1/16 + 0 * x, x_lim = c(0, 4), y_lim = c(0, 4),
  domain_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(4, 0), c(4, 4), c(0, 4)),
  in_event = function(x, y) abs(x - y) < 2,
  event_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(2, 0), c(4, 2), c(4, 4), c(2, 4), c(0, 2)),
  z_max = 0.1
)
```

## Example 3, part 2: volume for $\mathbb{P}(M \leq 2)$ {#ex3-max}

$M = \max(X, Y) \leq 2$ is the same event as $X \leq 2$ and $Y \leq 2$.

```{r}
plotly_pdf_volume(
  f = function(x, y) 1/16 + 0 * x, x_lim = c(0, 4), y_lim = c(0, 4),
  domain_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(4, 0), c(4, 4), c(0, 4)),
  in_event = function(x, y) pmax(x, y) <= 2,
  event_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(2, 0), c(2, 2), c(0, 2)), z_max = 0.1
)
```

## Example 4: the joint pdf {#ex4-pdf}

$f_{X,Y}(x,y) = 2e^{-(x+y)}$, for $0 \leq x \leq y$ (shown up to 4; it keeps going). The surface is tallest near $(0, 0)$.

```{r}
plotly_pdf_volume(
  f = function(x, y) 2 * exp(-(x + y)), x_lim = c(0, 4), y_lim = c(0, 4),
  in_domain = function(x, y) x <= y,
  domain_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(0, 4), c(4, 4)), z_max = 2
)
```

## Example 5 (for home): volume for $\mathbb{P}(Y < 3)$ {#ex5-volume}

```{r}
plotly_pdf_volume(
  f = function(x, y) 2 * exp(-(x + y)), x_lim = c(0, 4), y_lim = c(0, 4),
  in_domain = function(x, y) x <= y,
  domain_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(0, 4), c(4, 4)),
  in_event = function(x, y) y < 3,
  event_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(0, 3), c(3, 3)), z_max = 2
)
```

## Example 3, part 3 (for home): volume for $\mathbb{P}(Z \leq 2)$ {#ex3-min}

$Z = \min(X, Y) \leq 2$: at least one of $X$ and $Y$ is at most 2.

```{r}
plotly_pdf_volume(
  f = function(x, y) 1/16 + 0 * x, x_lim = c(0, 4), y_lim = c(0, 4),
  domain_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(4, 0), c(4, 4), c(0, 4)),
  in_event = function(x, y) pmin(x, y) <= 2,
  event_corners = rbind(c(0, 0), c(4, 0), c(4, 2), c(2, 2), c(2, 4), c(0, 4)),
  z_max = 0.1
)
```

## Example 6 (for home): volume for $\mathbb{P}(Z \leq \frac14)$ {#ex6-volume}

$f_{X,Y}(x,y) = \frac85(x + y)$, for $0 < x < 1$, $\frac12 < y < 1$, and $Z = XY$.

```{r}
curve_y <- seq(0.5, 1, by = 0.05)

plotly_pdf_volume(
  f = function(x, y) 8/5 * (x + y), x_lim = c(0, 1), y_lim = c(0.5, 1),
  domain_corners = rbind(c(0, 0.5), c(1, 0.5), c(1, 1), c(0, 1)),
  in_event = function(x, y) x * y <= 1/4,
  event_corners = rbind(c(0, 0.5), cbind(1 / (4 * curve_y), curve_y), c(0, 1)),
  z_max = 3.3
)
```
